text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- One disaster after another : more bomb attacks in Algiers.
- The state will underwrite debts of dissolved state-owned companies.
- Car bomb explosion kills six and wounds 44 in Algiers.
- Officials vows to streamline the national soccer federation.
- Algiers under the spectre of death and terror.
- Union leader Abdelhaq Benhamouda's plan to set up a political party had triggered turmoil in the union umbrella, Union Generale des Travailleurs Algeriens (UGTA).
- Two car bombs explode in Algiers
- Hamas party leader Mahfoud Nahnah initiative to end violence brings Hamas on pre-election campaign orbit.
